name: EPIC 211333485
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 14.9 solar radii and 1.22 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211333485 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 14.889114 (16th-84th percentiles 14.063555-15.772599), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,335 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.22 solar masses and 14.9 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,584 K at its surface.
